method: v2 (owner t754u). Percentile ranks within the industry peer set (SIC 3-digit, else 2-digit, ≥ 6 peers; 70% industry + 30% whole list). Growth quality 33% (½ blended y/y revenue growth, 0.3 multi-year consistency, 0.2 acceleration) · margin quality 22% (gross-margin level + trend, operating margin + trend, Rule of 40) · valuation 18% (EV/Gross profit ÷ peer median when gross margin > 5%, else EV/Sales; lower = better) · financial strength 17% (cash runway, share dilution, accruals, return on capital employed) · stickiness 10% (RPO / deferred revenue growth vs revenue growth; not counted against coverage). Missing parts reweighted; < 60% coverage → partial, not ranked. Danger (separate): high burn (FCF margin < −15% or runway < 18 months) AND severe burn, falling margins, working-capital build, dilution > 10%, or a weak retention proxy.
